operations.name: render.add_to_queue
operations.description: Add a composition to the render queue. Optionally set output path.

params.name: outputPath
params.description: Output file path (optional, sets on the first output module)

operations.name: render.start
operations.description: Start rendering the render queue. Blocks until complete.

operations.name: render.clear_queue
operations.description: Remove all items from the render queue.

operations.name: render.set_output
operations.description: Configure a render-queue item: render/output templates, output path, time span, render flag, skipFrames, logType, postRenderAction. Discover template names with render.list_templates; raw settings via render.get_settings / render.set_settings.

params.name: renderTemplate
params.description: Render settings template name (e.g. "Best Settings", "Draft Settings")

params.name: timeSpanStart
params.description: Render span start in seconds (comp time)

params.name: render
params.description: Whether this item renders when the queue starts (the Render checkbox)

params.name: skipFrames
params.description: Render every Nth frame (0 = every frame)

params.name: includeSourceXMP
params.description: Embed source-footage XMP metadata in the output

operations.name: render.get_settings
operations.description: Read the raw render settings of a queue item and the settings of each of its output modules (getSettings, AE 13.0+). format 'settable' returns only keys accepted by render.set_settings / render.set_om_settings.

operations.name: render.set_settings
operations.description: Set raw render settings on a queue item (RenderQueueItem.setSettings, AE 13.0+), e.g. { "Quality": "Best", "Resolution": "Half" }. Discover valid keys/values with render.get_settings.

operations.name: render.set_om_settings
operations.description: Set raw output-module settings on a queue item (OutputModule.setSettings, AE 13.0+), e.g. { "Format": "QuickTime", "Channels": "RGB + Alpha" }. Discover valid keys/values with render.get_settings.

operations.name: render.remove_item
operations.description: Remove ONE item from the render queue by its 1-based index (render.clear_queue removes all).

params.name: queueIndex
params.description: 1-based queue item index (explicit — no default for a destructive op)

operations.name: render.duplicate_item
operations.description: Duplicate a render-queue item (RenderQueueItem.duplicate) — e.g. to render the same comp with a second settings/output combination.

operations.name: render.list_templates
operations.description: List available render-settings templates and output-module templates. The render queue must have at least one item (templates are read from a queue item).

operations.name: render.status
operations.description: Report the render queue state: per-item status, time spans, and output paths.

operations.name: render.queue_in_ame
operations.description: Send the render queue to Adobe Media Encoder (for H.264/HEVC etc.). Requires AME installed. renderImmediately=true starts the AME queue.

params.name: renderImmediately
params.description: Start rendering in AME right away (default false)

operations.name: render.save_template
operations.description: Save a queue item's current render settings, or an output module's current settings, as a named template (saveAsTemplate) for reuse via render.set_output.

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true. This operation changes the user's After Effects APPLICATION configuration (it persists beyond the project) — set it only when the user explicitly requested this change, never as a side effect of other work.

operations.name: render.frame
operations.description: Render one frame to PNG (raw saveFrameToPng). As the LAST child of a batch.run, one call mutates and hands back visual proof. outPath must be absolute; raise ae_do's timeoutMs for slow renders. CAUTION: in color-managed projects (project.get_settings workingSpace != 'None') this writes raw working-space values that look dark/wrong — use the ae_render_frame TOOL there, which converts to display sRGB.

params.name: outPath
params.description: Absolute path for the PNG (parent directories are created)

operations.name: project.open
operations.description: Open a .aep project file. Closes the current project without saving.

params.name: save
params.description: Save current project before closing (default false)

operations.name: project.import_file
operations.description: Import a file (image, video, audio) into the project as footage. Pass sequence=true with the first file of an image sequence to import the whole sequence.

params.name: sequence
params.description: Import as image sequence starting at path (default false)

params.name: forceAlphabetical
params.description: Sequence only: force alphabetical order (default false)

params.name: importAs
params.description: footage|comp|compRetainLayerSizes|project — for layered files like .psd/.ai (default footage)

params.name: rangeStart
params.description: Sequence only: first frame number to import (ImportOptions.rangeStart)

params.name: rangeEnd
params.description: Sequence only: last frame number to import (ImportOptions.rangeEnd)

operations.name: project.undo
operations.description: Undo the last action. Equivalent to Ctrl+Z. Each prior ae_do call is ONE undo step (its automatic undo group), so count=1 reverts the whole previous call, batch included.

operations.name: project.purge
operations.description: Purge AE memory/disk caches. Use when AE is consuming too much RAM.

operations.name: project.replace_font
operations.description: Replace a font throughout the entire project. Useful for font substitution.

params.name: fromFont
params.description: Current font postscript name to replace

operations.name: project.auto_fix_expressions
operations.description: Find and replace text in all expressions across the project. Useful after renaming layers/comps.

operations.name: project.clear
operations.description: Remove ALL items from the project. Destructive — use with caution.

operations.name: project.delete_item
operations.description: Delete a project item by id.

operations.name: project.find_layers
operations.description: Search layers by name pattern and/or type across one or all comps.

params.name: comp
params.description: Restrict to one comp (name or id). Omit to search all.

params.name: namePattern
params.description: Case-insensitive substring match on layer name

operations.name: project.list_effects
operations.description: List available effect matchNames in the running AE. Uses app.effects if available, otherwise a curated list.

operations.name: project.set_settings
operations.description: Set project-wide settings: color depth, expression engine, working color space, time display.

params.name: workingSpace
params.description: Working color space name (see project.get_settings includeColorProfiles), or '' for None

params.name: displayStartFrame
params.description: Frame count starts at 0 or 1 (when counting frames)

operations.name: project.get_settings
operations.description: Read project-wide settings: color depth, expression engine, working color space, time display. Pass includeColorProfiles=true to list installed color profile names.

params.name: includeColorProfiles
params.description: Also return installed color profile names (default false)

operations.name: project.reduce
operations.description: Reduce the project to only the given comps and everything they use (Project.reduceProject). Removes all other items — save a copy first.

params.name: comps
params.description: Comp names or ids to keep

operations.name: project.remove_unused_footage
operations.description: Remove all footage items that are not used in any comp (Project.removeUnusedFootage).

operations.name: project.consolidate_footage
operations.description: Merge duplicate footage items into one and update layer references (Project.consolidateFootage).

operations.name: project.import_placeholder
operations.description: Create a placeholder footage item (Project.importPlaceholder) to build comps before the real footage exists. Relink later with footage.replace.

operations.name: project.new
operations.description: Create a NEW empty project (app.newProject). Closes the current project — pass save=true to save it first (only works when it has a file path). Destructive to unsaved work.

params.name: save
params.description: Save the current project before closing (default false; needs a file path)

operations.name: project.parse_swatch
operations.description: Parse an Adobe swatch file (.ase) and return its colors (app.parseSwatchFile) - feed brand palettes to fills, solids, and text colors.

operations.name: project.get_xmp
operations.description: Read the project's XMP metadata packet (Project.xmpPacket) as an RDF/XML string.

operations.name: project.set_xmp
operations.description: Replace the project's XMP metadata packet (Project.xmpPacket). Pass a complete, well-formed RDF/XML packet - AE does not validate fragments.

operations.name: project.set_default_import_folder
operations.description: Set the folder shown by default in the file import dialog (Project.setDefaultImportFolder).

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true. This operation changes the user's After Effects APPLICATION configuration (it persists beyond the project) — set it only when the user explicitly requested this change, never as a side effect of other work.

operations.name: project.get_tool
operations.description: Read the active tool in the Tools panel (Project.toolType, AE 14.0+).

operations.name: project.set_tool
operations.description: Set the active tool in the Tools panel (Project.toolType, AE 14.0+): selection|rotate|hand|zoom|panBehind|rect|roundedRect|ellipse|polygon|star|textHorizontal|textVertical|pen|maskFeather|brush|cloneStamp|eraser|puppetPin|puppetStarch|puppetBend|puppetAdvanced|puppetOverlap|cameraUnified|cameraOrbit|cameraTrackXY|cameraTrackZ|cameraOrbitCursor|cameraOrbitScene|cameraOrbitCamera|cameraPanCursor.

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true. This operation changes the user's After Effects APPLICATION configuration (it persists beyond the project) — set it only when the user explicitly requested this change, never as a side effect of other work.

operations.name: project.set_memory_limits
operations.description: Set AE memory usage limits (app.setMemoryUsageLimits): image cache percent and maximum memory percent. Percentages over 100 are allowed (AE interprets them against installed RAM).

params.name: imageCachePercent
params.description: Image cache size as % of installed RAM

params.name: maxMemoryPercent
params.description: Maximum AE memory as % of installed RAM

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true. This operation changes the user's After Effects APPLICATION configuration (it persists beyond the project) — set it only when the user explicitly requested this change, never as a side effect of other work.

operations.name: project.set_multi_frame_rendering
operations.description: Configure Multi-Frame Rendering (app.setMultiFrameRenderingConfig, AE 22.0+): on/off and the maximum CPU percentage MFR may use.

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true. This operation changes the user's After Effects APPLICATION configuration (it persists beyond the project) — set it only when the user explicitly requested this change, never as a side effect of other work.

operations.name: viewer.get_state
operations.description: Read the active viewer's state: type, zoom, exposure, channels.

operations.name: viewer.set_options
operations.description: Set active-viewer view options: zoom (1 = 100%), exposure (stops), checkerboard, guide/ruler visibility and lock/snap (AE 16.1+), fast-preview mode, and the displayed channels.
